title: Français 4696 / 4698 — graphical cipher, ff5r/62r–v, ff30r–
contents: Confidential warnings and cavalry arrangements: horses, payments, dispatches and service in war. The Français 4698 fragment contains a request for an appeal or intercession; most of that letter remains unread. The Paris letter of16 February1590 discusses friendship, the King of Spain and a request; its substantial gaps remain unread.
status: 2/7 pages transcribed; 5 more in part; 7/7 pages deciphered in part
fields: Scipion de Gonzague (Français 4696); not established for Français 4698
Duke of Nevers (Français 4696); not established for Français 4698
66 symbols/codes: 41 letter signs, 1 digraph, 24 in nomenclature
3,078 recorded groups, 1,147 identified; 8 further groups with unresolved boundaries
Français 4696, f5r: interlinear plaintext for this cipher.
Français 4698: corresponding historical enciphering/plaintext worksheets on f26r/f93r and the f17v/f105 comparison support the checked f104r marked codes.
